narrative.intro: Brasfield and Gorrie obligated $416M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, across 16 awards with an average award size of $26M. Brasfield and Gorrie obligations fell 5.8% year over year. Brasfield and Gorrie received the majority of FY2026 obligations from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $326M. Brasfield and Gorrie also received obligations from the Department of Defense, the General Services Administration, the Department of Justice, and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, totaling $59.6M, $21.1M, $9.8M, and $200K respectively. Brasfield and Gorrie reported Commercial and Institutional Building Construction as the largest NAICS market with $416M in obligations. Brasfield and Gorrie had smaller obligations in Engineering Services and Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction, with $200K and $10K respectively. The FY2026 totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity for Brasfield and Gorrie.

sections.heading: Who are Brasfield and Gorrie’s top federal buyers?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is the top buyer, obligating $326M to Brasfield and Gorrie in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense is the second largest buyer with $59.6M in obligations. The General Services Administration and the Department of Justice follow with $21.1M and $9.8M respectively, and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration obligated $200K.

sections.heading: How have Brasfield and Gorrie’s obligations changed over recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Brasfield and Gorrie obligations by fiscal year were $178M in FY21, $154M in FY22, $679M in FY23, $587M in FY24, $442M in FY25, and $416M in FY26. Brasfield and Gorrie obligations fell 5.8% year over year into FY2026 to date. The FY2026 figure is partial and represents fiscal year to date activity.

faq.q: How much does Brasfield and Gorrie make from federal contracts?

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Brasfield and Gorrie?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security is the largest buyer, obligating $326M to Brasfield and Gorrie in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense, the General Services Administration, the Department of Justice, and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration also bought from Brasfield and Gorrie, obligating $59.6M, $21.1M, $9.8M, and $200K respectively.

faq.q: What does Brasfield and Gorrie sell to the government?
faq.a: Brasfield and Gorrie sells construction and related services to the government, with Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounting for $416M in obligations in FY2026 to date. Brasfield and Gorrie also had obligations in Engineering Services and Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction, with $200K and $10K respectively.
